desc:
🎄 CATMAS UPDATE! Snowy lobby and maps, plus a limited Christmas Crate with 10 exclusive skins and trails (ends Jan 3).

🐱 CATS VS DOGS 🐶 is a team party game. Pick your side, then battle the other team in fast, random minigames!

⚔️ 15+ minigames: Spleef, Sumo, Hockey, Hot Potato, Tug of War, Musical Beds and more
🔨 Bonk the other team off the map
🍪 Earn Treats to unlock hats, skins, trails and upgrades
🎁 Free daily rewards and a Lucky Wheel
👥 Invite friends for bonus Treats

Which pet is better? Prove it.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more updates!
